title: TRUNK-6681: Improve LocationSearchCriteria query performance with pagination
body:
Apply SQL-level pagination for location searches and add regression tests to verify paged behavior and prevent broad in-memory loading.

<!--- Add a pull request title above in this format -->
<!--- real example: 'TRUNK-5111: Replace use of deprecated isVoided' -->
[TRUNK-6681: Improve LocationSearchCriteria query performance with pagination](https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/TRUNK-6681)
## Description of what I changed
This pull request adds pagination support to location searches and enhances test coverage to ensure efficient querying and filtering. The main changes include introducing pagination parameters to `LocationSearchCriteria`, updating the DAO to apply these parameters, and adding tests to verify correct pagination and efficient filtering.

### Pagination support for location queries

* Added `startIndex` and `maxResults` fields, along with their getters and setters, to `LocationSearchCriteria` to support pagination of search results. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-562863b444a787cf7e601c95c6472d42a8b4f9a59732e2e4049be92d3232cfe3R45-R48) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-562863b444a787cf7e601c95c6472d42a8b4f9a59732e2e4049be92d3232cfe3R85-R98) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-562863b444a787cf7e601c95c6472d42a8b4f9a59732e2e4049be92d3232cfe3R133-R146)
* Updated `HibernateLocationDAO#getLocations` to apply the pagination parameters (`setFirstResult` and `setMaxResults`) when provided in the criteria.

### Test coverage improvements

* Added tests in `LocationServiceTest` to verify that pagination works as expected and is applied after other filters.
* Added a test in `HibernateLocationDAOTest` to ensure that filtering by a selective name fragment does not load all locations, confirming efficient query execution.
